sentences.en: It is a stereotype that police officers always eat doughnuts.
sentences.zh: 认为警察总是吃甜甜圈是一种刻板印象。

sentences.en: It's unfair to stereotype all young people as potential troublemakers.
sentences.zh: 把所有年轻人视为潜在的问题制造者是不公平的刻板印象。

sentences.en: There is a stereotype of opera singers as being fat.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为歌剧歌手都很胖，这是一种刻板形象。

senses.zh: 老套, 模式化的见解, 有老一套固定想法的人 -
把…模式化, 使成陈规
